blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ego-Exo4D is a large-scale dataset providing synchronized egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, a rich resource for skill learning and assessment, procedural activity understanding, and embodied AI. However, the dataset ships with only sparse 3D human pose annotations, and reconstructing dense human motion from its multi-view captures is nontrivial. To this end, we present Ego-Exo4D-HM, a large-scale dataset of 4D human motion reconstructions for Ego-Exo4D’s captures, and release the accompanying reconstruction pipeline. The code, dataset, and documentation can be found at https://abhiram824.github.io/egoexo4d_human_meshes/ .
blocks.zh: Ego-Exo4D是一个大型数据集,提供同步自我中心与多视图异心视频,是技能学习和评估,程序活动理解的丰富资源,并包含AI. 然而,只有稀疏的3D人类的数据集船会提出说明,从它的多景捕捉中重建密集的人类运动是非三角性的. 为此,我们提出Ego-Exo4D-HM,这是一个大型的4D人类运动重建数据集,用于Ego-Exo4D的捕获,并释放了配套的重建管道. 代码、数据集和文件可在https://abhiram824.github.io/egoexo4d_human_meshes/上查阅。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ego4D Grauman et al. (2022) and Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) are among the largest efforts in egocentric data collection, providing thousands of hours of video across a wide range of activities and participants. Datasets of this scale open the door to pipelines for skill learning and assessment, procedural activity understanding, embodied AI and robot imitation learning, and coaching or tutoring systems that give feedback on physical performance.
blocks.zh: Ego4D Grauman等人(2022年)和Ego-Exo4D Grauman等人(2024年)是收集以自我为中心的数据的最大努力之一,在广泛的活动和参与者中提供了数千小时的视频. 这种规模的数据集为技能学习和评估、程序活动理解、体现AI和机器人仿真学习以及提供物理性能反馈的辅导或辅导系统的管道打开了大门。

blocks.en: Ego-Exo4D in particular is a rich dataset, with extensive capture including an egocentric sensor alongside multiple exocentric cameras, all synchronized and calibrated. This multi-view setup should, in principle, significantly improve the quality of 3D human perception, since the exocentric cameras observe the full body of the person performing the activity. However, the dataset’s existing 3D annotations are sparse, and current 3D human reconstruction systems can be brittle at this scale.
blocks.zh: 特别是Ego-Exo4D是一个丰富的数据集,其广泛的捕捉包括一个以自我为中心的传感器,与多个偏心相机并列,全部同步并校准. 这种多视图设置原则上应大大提高3D人类感知的质量,因为外心相机观察着进行活动的人的全身. 然而,数据集现有的3D说明很少,目前的3D人类重建系统在这个规模上可能很简陋.

blocks.en: To enable broader use of the dataset, we develop a pipeline for recovering the 4D human motion of Ego-Exo4D’s captures. Our approach builds on state-of-the-art methods for 3D human pose reconstruction Ye et al. (2023) ; Goel et al. (2023) ; Pavlakos et al. (2024) , adapted to take advantage of Ego-Exo4D’s synchronized multi-camera setup. We release the resulting SMPL-H motion sequences as the Ego-Exo4D-HM dataset (see Figure 1 ), along with our processing pipeline, so future work can use this data directly rather than reprocessing the raw captures.
blocks.zh: 为了更广泛地使用数据集,我们开发了一条管道,以恢复Ego-Exo4D捕获的4D人类运动。 我们的办法是利用Ego-Exo4D同步的多相机设置,在3D人类姿势重建方面采用最先进的方法。 我们发布由此产生的SMPL-H运动序列作为Ego-Exo4D-HM数据集(见图1),连同我们的处理管道,因此今后的工作可以直接使用这些数据,而不是再处理原始捕获.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Our pipeline builds on video-based human mesh recovery methods that turn per-frame estimates, such as those from HMR2.0 Goel et al. (2023) , into temporally consistent 4D motion. Methods like WHAM Shin et al. (2024) and GVHMR Shen et al. (2024) do this in a feed-forward fashion; however, it is challenging to incorporate information from multiple views this way. Instead, we adopt an optimization-based formulation that naturally accepts additional constraints. Specifically, we build on SLAHMR Ye et al. (2023) , which jointly optimizes pose and root trajectory using 2D body keypoints and a learned motion prior.
Our pipeline is related to prior frameworks, like EasyMocap Shuai et al. (2021) , which operates with multiple calibrated views, but also considers egocentric captures and relies on more recent human pose estimation approaches.
MAMMA Cuevas-Velasquez et al. (2026) performs markerless multi-view motion capture directly from raw video streams. We show a short comparison in Section 4 .
blocks.zh:
我们的管道以视频为基础的人类网状恢复方法为基础,这些方法将每帧估计数,如HMR2.0 Goel等人(2023年)的估计数,转化为时间上一致的4D运动。 WHAM Shin等人(2024年)和GVHMR Shen等人(2024年)等方法都是以向前进的方式这样做的;然而,以这种方式纳入来自多种观点的信息是困难的。 相反,我们采用了一种基于优化的提法,自然接受更多的限制。 具体地说,我们借鉴了SLAHMR Ye等人(2023年),他们利用2D体键点和事先学会的运动,共同优化了姿势和根轨迹。
我们的管道与先前的框架有关,例如Easy Mocap Shuai等人(2021年),它以多种校准观点运作,但也考虑自我中心捕捉,并依赖更近期的人类姿势估计方法。
MAMMA Cuevas-Velasquez等人(2026年)直接从原始视频流中进行无标记的多视图运动捕捉. 我们在第4节中略作比较。

blocks.en: Previous work has independently considered the problem of egocentric body pose recovery. EgoEgo Li et al. (2023) relies only on the SLAM trajectory of the head-mounted camera, without access to image observations, while more recent work, EgoAllo Yi et al. (2025) , incorporates hand observations estimated from egocentric images. The exocentric cameras of Ego-Exo4D simplify the problem in this setting, since they are observing the body from multiple views.
blocks.zh: 以往的工作独立地考虑了以自我为中心的身体问题,从而带来了复苏。 叶子 Ego Li等人(2023年)只依靠头架相机的SLAM轨迹,无法获取图像观测,而更近期的作品EgoAllo Yi等人. (2025年),结合了以自我为中心的图像估计的手观察. Ego-Exo4D的外向摄像头简化了这个设置中的问题,因为他们从多个角度观察身体.

blocks.en: Our work is heavily motivated by growing use of human motion and activity data in embodied AI. Many works Luo et al. (2026) ; Ze et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025a) ; He et al. (2025) have leveraged diverse motion capture data of human activity to train performant humanoid whole-body controllers. Another line of work Kareer et al. (2025) ; Qiu et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Shi et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025b) uses RGB videos of humans doing tasks to learn visuomotor manipulation policies. Human activity videos have also been useful in learning expressive action-conditioned video models and world models Gao et al. (2026) ; Goswami et al. (2026) ; Bai et al. (2025) . We hope that our dataset can be useful in advancing these research directions.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作很大程度上是由于越来越多地使用人工智能中的人类运动和活动数据。 许多著作有:Luo等人(2026);Ze等人(2025);Li等人(2025a); 他等人(2025年)利用了人类活动的各种运动捕捉数据,培养了表演的人体整体控制器. 另一行作品Kareer等人(2025年);邱等人(2025年);李等人(2026年);史等人(2025年);李等人(2025年);李等人(2025年b年)使用RGB的视频来完成人类的任务,学习维乌莫托操纵政策. 人类活动视频在学习表现性动作条件视频模型和世界模型Gao等人(2026年);Goswami等人(2026年);Bai等人(2025年)方面也有所帮助. 我们希望我们的数据集能够有助于推进这些研究方向。

blocks.en: Beyond embodied AI, understanding and modeling human activity is also central to skill assessment, coaching, and video forecasting. Previous work has used estimates of 3D motion in egocentric settings to provide actionable feedback Ashutosh et al. (2025a) , predict future interactions Ashutosh et al. (2025b) , forecast hand motion Hatano et al. (2025) , and edit novice motion toward an expert’s skill level Somayazulu and Grauman (2026) . We anticipate that populating ego-exo captures with dense 3D motion estimates at scale will be valuable for supporting these methods.
blocks.zh: 除了体现的AI之外,理解和模拟人类活动也是技能评估、辅导和视频预报的核心。 先前的作品用3D运动在自我中心环境下的估计来提供可操作的反馈 Ashutosh 等人(2025a),预测未来的互动 Ashutosh 等人(2025b),预测手动波多野等人(2025),编辑新动向专家技能水平Somayazulu和Grauman(2026). 我们预计,以密集的3D运动估计量来捕捉自我 -- Exo,对于支持这些方法将很有价值。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

(2024) , our goal is to reconstruct world-frame 3D body and hand motion of the person performing the activity. We build off SLAHMR Ye et al. (2023) , which can be naturally extended to multi-view settings.

blocks.en: Our mesh recovery pipeline modifies SLAHMR Ye et al. (2023) to leverage Ego-Exo4D’s exocentric calibrations and egocentric SLAM estimates. Concretely, our pipeline consists of 3 stages: (1) Single-view pose estimation, (2) Triangulation, and (3) SMPL-H Optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们的网点恢复管道修改了SLAHMR Ye等人(2023年), 具体而言,我们的管道包括三个阶段: (1) 单一观点提出估计, (2)三角,和(3)SMPL-H优化.

blocks.en: 3.1 Single-view pose estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1 单一观点提出估计

blocks.en: Takes frequently contain bystanders, so we first identify the camera wearer in each exocentric view. We run a Mask R-CNN He et al. (2017) detector with a RegNetY-4GF Radosavovic et al. (2020) backbone and keep the detection whose box contains the wearer’s projected 3D head position, given by the Aria SLAM trajectory. For each selected box we run ViTPose Xu et al. (2022) to obtain human body keypoints and use HaMeR Pavlakos et al. (2024) to obtain hand keypoints. In total we get 67 hand and body keypoints.
blocks.zh: 经常包含旁观者,所以我们首先在每一个偏心视图中识别摄像头穿戴者. 我们运行一个面具R -CNN He et al。 (2017)带有RegNetY-4GF Radosavovic等人(2020)骨干骨架的探测器,并保留由Aria SLAM轨迹给出的包含穿戴者预测的3D头部位置的探测器. 对于每个选定的盒子,我们运行了ViTPose Xu等人(2022年),以获得人体键位,并使用HaMeR Pavlakos等人(2024年)获取手键位. 我们总共得到了67个手和身体的关键点。

blocks.en: 3.2 Triangulation
blocks.zh: 3.2 三角关系

blocks.en: Each of the 67 keypoints is triangulated independently per frame by minimizing reprojection error over all calibrated views, using nonlinear least squares over the 3D point; at least two views are required. For the hand and wrist keypoints, which are more prone to occlusion and misdetection, we additionally run RANSAC Fischler and Bolles (1981) over views to reject outlier detections.
blocks.zh: 每个67个键点通过最小化所有校准视图的再投射误差,在3D点上使用非线性最小的方块,每个框独立进行三角化;至少需要两个视图. 对于手和腕键点,它们更容易被隔离和误测,我们额外运行RANSAC Fischler和Bolles(1981年)对视图进行检测,以拒绝外部检测。

blocks.en: 3.3 SMPL-H Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 SMPL-H优化

blocks.en: The final stage adapts SLAHMR’s optimization to the calibrated multi-view setting. The free variables are the per-frame global translation Γ t \Gamma_{t} , root orientation Φ t \Phi_{t} , body and hand pose Θ t \Theta_{t} , and a single shape vector β \beta per take. All camera parameters are frozen to their calibrated values, so the motion is recovered directly in the metric Ego-Exo4D world frame. We utilize the same optimization process as SLAHMR Ye et al. (2023) , but do not use the motion prior as the triangulated 3D evidence already constrains global motion.
blocks.zh: 最终阶段将SLAHMR的优化适应了校准的多视图设置. 自由变量是每帧翻译 = t\ Gamma_{t}, 根方向 = t\ Phi_{t}, 身体和手 = t\ Theta_{t}, 和每个带的单个形状矢量 β\ beta 。 所有相机参数都被冻结到其校准值,因此运动直接在公制Ego-Exo4D世界框架中恢复. 我们使用与SLAHMR Ye等人(2023年)相同的优化过程,但不要使用之前的运动,因为三角立体证据已经限制了全球运动。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Curated Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 加密数据集

blocks.en: We ran our pipeline on a subset of approximately 3,200 videos from the Ego-Exo4D dataset. From here we apply a quality filter based on two per-take criteria. 1. Reprojection self-consistency : we reproject the final optimized 3D joints through the calibrated cameras and measure the pixel distance to the corresponding 2D detections; a take is flagged if more than 10% of these samples exceed 50 px. 2. Triangulation coverage : a take is flagged if fewer than 50% of its keypoint observations were successfully triangulated, which catches takes reconstructed from too few agreeing views.
blocks.zh: 我们运行我们的管道的子集 大约3200个视频 从Ego -Exo4D数据集。 从这里开始,我们使用一个质量过滤器 基于两个每摄取标准。 1. 重新预测自我一致性:我们通过校准相机对最终优化的3D关节进行重新预测,并测量像素距离到相应的2D检测;如果超过10%的样品超过50px,则标出摄像头。 2. 三角覆盖:如果成功测算了不到50%的临界点观测结果,就会标出摄像头,而摄像头的捕获量则是从太少的一致看法中重建的。

blocks.en: Reprojection self-consistency : we reproject the final optimized 3D joints through the calibrated cameras and measure the pixel distance to the corresponding 2D detections; a take is flagged if more than 10% of these samples exceed 50 px.
blocks.zh: 重新预测自兼容性:我们通过校准的相机重新预测最终优化的3D关节,并测量像素距离到相应的2D检测;如果超过10%的样本超过50px,则标出一个摄像头.

blocks.en: Triangulation coverage : a take is flagged if fewer than 50% of its keypoint observations were successfully triangulated, which catches takes reconstructed from too few agreeing views.
blocks.zh: 三角覆盖:如果成功测算了不到50%的临界点观测结果,就会标出摄像头。

blocks.zh: 图2:我国输油管与MAMMA Cuevas-Velasquez等人(2026年)的比较。

blocks.en: A take failing either criterion is discarded, removing 551 takes (17.1%) and retaining 2,649. Ego-Exo4D-HM totals 104.59 hours of reconstructed motion; since each take provides four exocentric views and an egocentric view, the dataset totals 522.96 hours of video. For each take we release npz files containing the optimized SMPL-H parameters ( Γ t , Φ t , Θ t , β ) (\Gamma_{t},\Phi_{t},\Theta_{t},\beta) , the calibrated per-frame camera intrinsics and world-to-camera extrinsics, and the 3D joints 𝐉 t \mathbf{J}_{t} together with their 2D reprojections in each view, from which the mesh vertices 𝐕 t \mathbf{V}_{t} and keypoints in any view can be regenerated via Eq. ( 2 ).
blocks.zh: 不采用任何一项标准,则放弃,去除551项(17.1%),保留2 649项。 Ego-Exo4D-HM共重建运动104.59小时;由于每集提供4个异心观和一个自负观,数据集共提供522.96小时的视频. 每次我们都会发布包含优化的 SMPL-H 参数的 npz 文件( = t, = t, = t, β) (\ Gamma_{t},\ Phi_{t},\ Theta_{t},\beta), 校准的每帧相机内含和世界对相机外观, 以及3D 关节 Jt\mathbf{J}_{t} 及其在每个视图中的2D 重排, 从中可以通过 Eq. ( 2) 重生成 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: We evaluate reconstruction accuracy against the ground-truth 3D body and hand keypoint annotations provided by Ego-Exo4D. Since our reconstructions live directly in the dataset’s metric world frame, we report global MPJPE, i.e. the mean Euclidean distance between predicted and annotated 3D joints without any alignment. Our method achieves a global MPJPE of 56.21 mm for body keypoints (over 845 annotated takes) and 51.59 mm for hand keypoints (over 190 annotated takes).
blocks.zh: 我们对照地面真相3D体和Ego-Exo4D提供的手键点说明来评价重建的准确性。 由于我们的重建直接生活在数据集的度量世界框架,我们报告全球MPJPE,即预测和附加注释的3D关节之间的平均欧几里得距离,而没有任何对齐. 我们的方法实现了全身键位(超过845个注音)和手键位(超过190个注音)的全球MPJPE为56.21毫米.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with MAMMA
blocks.zh: 4.3 与MAMMA的比较

blocks.en: We additionally compare qualitatively with MAMMA Cuevas-Velasquez et al. (2026) , a recent multi-view mesh recovery method. On the partial body views, occlusions, and truncations common in Ego-Exo4D’s captures, we find that our pipeline produces more robust reconstructions than MAMMA; see Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们还在质量上与MAMMA Cuevas-Velasquez等人(2026年)进行比较,后者是最近一种多视图网状恢复方法。 关于Ego-Exo4D捕捉中常见的局部身体观点、隔离和短路,我们发现我们的输油管比MAMMA更能进行重建;参见图2。
